title: UPX / packed binary unpacking
steps: `file`, `readelf -S`, `strings | grep UPX`, and `upx -l binary`; check section names/entropy.
Try `upx -d binary -o unpacked`; if the magic is modified, restore `UPX!` at the header offset and retry.
If UPX is not the packer, run in the sandbox and dump at the original entry point (OEP) after the unpacking stub.
Re-run `readelf`/`strings`/Ghidra on the unpacked image; verify the entry point and imports are sane.
falsifier: The binary is not packed, or it is packed with a custom protector that needs dynamic unpacking.
